notes.title: Letters from the front
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]We wanted to share a couple of new screenshots from [i]Hollow Mire[/i].[/p][p]The first is from a flashback sequence near the end of the war, a wide summer vista, WWII trucks moving in convoy, and John in the back, writing a letter to Eve. It’s one of those moments where hope and unease live side by side.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674805/793656caa4aa5e330870ba02393435c54b82ff3c.png"][/img]
The second takes us back to Breken House, with a glimpse of the 2nd floor and part of the ground floor. A grandfather clock ticks as the lights flicker. Listen closely, and you may hear whispers drifting through this hall.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674805/1437cdde030576a3d6113ed97990e6eae82c3d6f.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks as always for following along, and we’ll have more to share soon.
[/p][p]♥️ The Hollow Mire Team[/p]

notes.title: The Asylum Holds Its Secrets
notes.content:
[h2]
[b]Gwen’s Investigation at Bordon Downs Asylum[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve just uploaded two new screenshots from Hollow Mire, a glimpse into Gwen Porter’s path through the asylum.[/p][p]In the first, Gwen finds herself at [b]Bordon Downs Asylum for the Insane[/b]. Against the backdrop of [b]screams echoing down the corridors[/b], she examines a [b]murder scene[/b], forced to piece together what happened in a place where truth and delusion intertwine.[/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674805/cf04693c2693b05132278e288c103943d6c844c4.png"][/img]  
[/p][p]The second screenshot drags us below, into the [b]dark, damp basement[/b] of the asylum. Among the dripping pipes and scattered debris, Gwen hunts for clues that may reveal where a missing patient has gone… though every step deeper feels like it leads further away from safety.[/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674805/a1c2499036d7dece0dbbd4a176e5b6ecd8a7491e.png"][/img][/p][p]These scenes show just one thread of [i]Hollow Mire’s[/i] dual narrative, where the search for answers demands walking into places that resist being understood.[/p][p]We’ll be sharing more of Gwen’s journey soon. For now, take a closer look at these screenshots and let us know your thoughts in the comments.[/p][p][i]– The Hollow Mire Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Three Faces You’ll Meet in Hollow Mire
notes.content:
[p]Every story in Hollow Mire begins with a face.
Some you’ll trust. Some you won’t. And some will stay with you long after you’ve left.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Frank Turpin  [/b]-   

Age - 65 
Bio - A 65-year-old groundskeeper, shaped by years of quiet village life. Fond of cats, less so of people.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674805/ac9390ea09f92e47d466972989bd9b72b5632dd1.png"][/img]
[b]John Rowe[/b] - [/p][p]Age - 34  
Bio - War hero turned investigative journalist, burdened by the weight of what he’s seen. Loves a good story, but fears the truths that hide in the unknown.      

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674805/61a3ce33f90150b3f8a2244f02265e8037dd6cd5.png"][/img]

[b]Gwen Porter[/b] - 

Age - 24
Bio - A wily, determined London detective with a sharp eye for detail. Thrives in the bustle of the city, but the stillness of the countryside sets her on edge.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674805/1b003b64c454fd4394d35b75df962fe44e8687ca.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]We’re sharing these portraits during [b]Steam’s Debut Festival[/b] (August 7 – August 11, 2026), where Hollow Mire will be featured alongside other first-time titles.[/p][p]If you’d like to follow our progress and help Hollow Mire reach more players, please consider adding it to your wishlist.[/p][p][b]💛 Wishlist Hollow Mire[/b][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3357160/HOLLOW_MIRE/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Dev Note #2: Visual Update - Portrait Unveiled – Meet Frank
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve just added the first of the new portraits to the game, one of several character reveals planned over the coming weeks. 

This one is for [b]Frank[/b], the groundskeeper at Breken House.
[/p][p]You’ll meet Frank early on, at a quiet rural station in the middle of nowhere. He’s waiting there when you arrive. Don't expect a warm welcome. Just a nod and a heavy silence that sets the tone for your journey through the snowy Devonshire roads to Breken House.[/p][p]
This new portrait aims to capture who Frank is beneath the surface, distant, quiet, and weighed down by a history he won’t speak of. 

He’s been part of the estate longer than anyone else, and his presence will set the tone for the night to come.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674805/ac9390ea09f92e47d466972989bd9b72b5632dd1.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ll be sharing more snippets of the world like this soon, little pieces, one at a time, as we get closer to the new trailer and start unveiling the bigger picture.
[/p][p]Thanks again for following along so early. It makes a real difference. And if you haven’t yet, please consider hitting that ⭐ Wishlist button, it helps the game more than you might think.
[/p][p]More soon,
— Mowlo [/p]

We didn’t want to wait to share this progress with you — and we’re grateful for everyone who’s already wishlisted or recommended the game along.[/p][quote][p]💬 What’s next:[/p][list][*][p]Trailer coming soon[/p][/*][*][p]More behind-the-scenes looks[/p][/*][*][p]Deeper story reveals and world-building content[/p][/*][/list][/quote][p]Thanks for being here early — it means a lot.
